decisive_items: Hematoxylin-eosin staining demonstrated concentric proliferation of ovoid tumor cells present around small vessels over a hyalinized background stroma
Smooth muscle actin (SMA) was diffusely positive in the tumor cells
CD31 immunostain highlighted many endothelial-lined vascular channels
response.rationale: The morphology of ovoid cells around vessels plus diffuse SMA positivity with negative desmin/h-caldesmon/STAT6 fits glomus tumor; angiosarcoma would be CD31-positive in tumor cells rather than SMA-dominant and lacks the perivascular pattern.

rejected.why: Clinical papule only; histology and SMA positivity not consistent
DFSP is CD34-positive, not SMA-positive; concentric perivascular pattern absent
Kaposi sarcoma typically HHV8-positive; here HHV8 negative and no slit-like vessels
Overly broad; CD31 highlights vessels but tumor cells are SMA-positive, not purely vascular
Benign hemangioma lacks SMA-positive tumor cells and mitotic/necrosis features
Dermatofibroma is SMA-positive but CD31 pattern and perivascular nests are atypical; lacks storiform dermal pattern
Angiosarcoma typically shows CD31 positivity in tumor cells, not SMA diffusely; morphology perivascular not vascular-forming
History of SCC is unrelated; histology and IHC do not support keratinocyte origin
